# Feature: Swap tile — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #93 (Swap tile) from Movement Tiles before it is used in real levels. Effect: Swap places with an adjacent block or bot; the game's only pull. Unique: swaps you with an entity, teleport pads swap nothing. Useful: frees a block stuck in a corner in one step. Source status in the candidate file is 'revised'; it was revised from human review and is now treated as a trial candidate.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** swap places with an adjacent block or bot; the game's only pull.

**So that** frees a block stuck in a corner in one step.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Swap tile for the first time in its teaching room (mech-93-swap-tile-room). Teaching moment: First room: a swap tile under a block in a narrow corridor, with an orb behind you. A player who swaps without considering both resulting positions ends up on the far side of a block that now closes their way back, so the restart teaches that a swap gives you the block's place and gives the block yours. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: A swap tile sits under a block or bot
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Stand next to it and press toward it and you exchange tiles with it, so you can pull a block out of a corner or get behind it without restarting
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: The swap tile stays and can be reused

## Edge Cases & Rules

- A swap tile sits under a block or bot
- Stand next to it and press toward it and you exchange tiles with it, so you can pull a block out of a corner or get behind it without restarting
- The swap tile stays and can be reused
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Swap tile's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-93-swap-tile-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/movement-tiles.yml mechanic #93.
